categories.main_business_segments: Anhui ActBlue Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of engine exhaust after-treatment products and atmospheric environmental protection products. Its main products include diesel and gasoline engine exhaust purification products meeting China VI emission standards, non-road mobile machinery exhaust purification products meeting China IV standards, and marine exhaust purification products meeting China II standards. The company also develops VOCs waste gas treatment equipment and is expanding into green energy and intelligent computing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include catalyst formulation and coating, electronic control technology, matching and calibration technology, and system integration technology. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for SCR catalysts, DPF filters, and three-way catalysts, with capabilities in catalyst mass production and system integration. The company also develops high-efficiency hydrogen fuel cell catalysts, PEM electrolysis catalysts, and battery PACK systems, leveraging proprietary catalyst and electro-control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are engine manufacturers and vehicle OEMs, including well-known enterprises such as Quanchai Power, Yuchai Machinery, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, Sany, and Foton Motor. The company serves markets in road vehicles, non-road mobile machinery (e.g., construction and agricultural machinery), and marine vessels. It also targets emerging sectors like hybrid vehicles, hydrogen fuel cells, and electric ships, expanding its customer base domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Anhui Province and subsidiaries across multiple Chinese provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Luxembourg, France, and Germany, serving international markets. Its export sales have increased, and it has obtained certifications from international classification societies, indicating a growing global footprint in marine and non-road sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: ActBlue operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and supply of engine exhaust after-treatment components and systems to engine and vehicle manufacturers. It procures raw materials such as electronic components, precious metals, and chemical materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products directly to OEMs and end users, including retrofit markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on green and intelligent development themes. It prioritizes R&D in advanced emission control technologies, including SCR catalysts for near-zero emissions, DPF technologies, and flexible fuel catalysts. It invests in hydrogen energy technologies, such as fuel cell catalysts and PEM electrolysis, and battery system integration. Additionally, it develops intelligent computing platforms and AI applications, collaborating with academic and research institutions to enhance innovation and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of engine exhaust after-treatment products and environmental protection equipment to engine manufacturers, vehicle OEMs, and retrofit customers. The company also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with zero inventory management for customers, and revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control at shipment or installation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ActBlue is a leading domestic player in the engine exhaust after-treatment industry, recognized as a high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It holds a strong market position in light diesel engine after-treatment and is expanding into heavy-duty diesel, gasoline, hybrid, non-road machinery, and marine sectors. Its competitors include other domestic and international emission control technology providers, but ActBlue’s comprehensive technology portfolio and broad customer base provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 946.5 million, a 9.56% decrease from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 366.61% to RMB 49.88 million. Total assets grew by 16.33% to RMB 2.05 billion, and net assets increased slightly. The company’s cash flow from operations turned positive with a significant increase, reflecting improved operational efficiency and financial health. It continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures around 5.52% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ActBlue emphasizes its advanced proprietary catalyst formulations, electronic control systems, and integrated solutions that meet the most stringent emission standards (China VI and beyond). Its products offer high performance, cost advantages, and reliability, supporting customers in achieving regulatory compliance and environmental goals. The company’s commitment to innovation in green energy and intelligent computing further differentiates it by addressing emerging market needs and sustainability trends.
